title: CAMS (Complex Adaptive Model State) / JUNO: A Framework for Societal Coordination Analysis
description: CAMS (Complex Adaptive Model State) / JUNO is a measurement framework for how societies absorb adaptive stress, rendering a society's institutional record as eight recurring functional nodes (Helm, Shield, Lore, Archive, Stewards, Craft, Hands, Flow), each scored annually on coherence, capacity, stress and abstraction, from which node viability and inter-node bond strength are computed. The framework places a society in its structural family, identifies which functions carry deformation under stress, and tracks whether a society routes stress through the same functions across separated historical episodes. It is diagnostic and morphological, not predictive: it does not forecast outcomes, and claims about recovery trajectories remain untested pending further validation.
